highlights_headline: Upcoming SkiaSharp changes use operating-system randomness for the shared hash-code seed.

bullets.detail: The HashCode polyfill shared by SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now seeds from RandomNumberGenerator rather than System.Random. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes; first use now loads cryptography support and has additional initialization cost.

contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Replaced the shared hash-code seed with operating-system randomness and added analyzer checks for shipped code.
